lines.text: Say you need me, need me

How did forever fade so soon? (Ah)

Stay with me (stay with me, me, me, me, me)

Count the cracks all across the floor (ah)
You were beside me, now you're not here (ah)
All of our plans in cardboard dreams (ah)
Packed in a bus that no one sees (ah)
I play our nights back frame by frame (ah)
Searching for when you slipped away (ah)

If you leave me, leave me, leave
I'll be alone, alone (be alone, alone)
